selection.objective: Minimum public-key+ciphertext bytes at each fixed weight pair among45 supported codecs, each with the first primitive prime above its code length, under the exact conditional correctness acceptance rule; not optimization at an established security level
selection.tie_break: public-key bytes, ciphertext bytes, RM repetitions, RS delta, ring length
selection.correctness: Exact rational Model1+deterministic tie correction and per-profile sampler-density upper bound; actual joint-noise transfer is an explicit conjectural premise
selection.security: No numeric security estimate or monotonic attack-cost theorem. Weights follow the2025HQC-1 balance; latest security calibration remains pending. Primitive prime ring and full native entropy are retained.
